title: Generation 1 Heroes
description: Natalia, Jeronimo, Molly, Zinman. Early game core. Focus on Sergey (Tank) and Jessie (Rally Joiner +25% Dmg).

title: Tundra Territory Opens
description: Alliance builds Level 4 banners towards the center of the map; high-yield resource nodes become gatherable.

title: Arena Pool Expansion
description: Arena opponent matchmaking expands across neighboring server brackets.

title: Generation 2 Heroes (Flint / Alonso / Philly)
description: Flint (Lucky Wheel #1 Tank), Alonso (HoH / King of Icefield carry), Philly (Support healer).

title: Chief Gear & Charms T1
description: Polish Chief Gear to T1 and socket initial elemental charms for squad Attack/Defense boosts.

title: First Sunfire Castle Battle
description: First battle for the central Sunfire Castle and Supreme Presidency title.

title: Pet Generation 1 & Beast Cage
description: Requires Furnace Lv 18. Construct Beast Cage to tame Cave Hyena, Arctic Wolf, and Musk Ox.

title: Fire Crystal Age (FC 1–3)
description: Requires Furnace Lv 30 & Monument task. Upgrade structures and troops to Fire Crystal 1, 2, and 3.

title: State vs State (SvS) & King of Icefield
description: First cross-state war! 6-day preparation phase (Castle prep) followed by Battle Phase.

title: Pet Generation 2 (Titan Roc & Giant Tapir)
description: Unlocks Titan Roc (March Speed) and Giant Tapir (Rally Defense).

title: State Transfer Event (Phase 1)
description: Eligible players can purchase Transfer Passes and relocate to neighboring states in the same bracket.

title: Generation 3 Heroes (Mia / Logan / Greg)
description: Mia (Lucky Wheel #1 Bear Trap burst carry), Logan (Arena/Garrison tank), Greg (Lancer flanker).

title: Pet Generation 3 (Snow Leopard & Giant Elk)
description: Unlocks Snow Leopard (Backline Lethality) and Giant Elk (Resource Gathering).

title: Fire Crystal 4–5 & Crystal Lab
description: Refine Fire Crystals into Refined Crystals to upgrade structures to FC 4 and FC 5.

title: Generation 4 Heroes (Lynn / Ahmose / Reina)
description: Lynn (Lucky Wheel armor-piercing Marksman), Ahmose (Invincible shield tank), Reina (Lancer burst).

title: Pet Generation 4 (Cave Lion & Snow Ape)
description: Unlocks Cave Lion (Squad stun) and Snow Ape (Frontline damage mitigation).

title: Dawn / War Academy & T11 Troops
description: Unlocks War Academy research. Train elite Tier 11 Infantry, Lancers, and Marksmen.

title: Generation 5 Heroes (Hector / Norah / Gwen)
description: Hector (Lucky Wheel #1 Fortress tank), Norah (Lancer flanker), Gwen (Marksman sniper).

title: Pet Generation 5 (Iron Rhino & Saber-tooth)
description: Unlocks Iron Rhino (Defense surge) and Saber-tooth (Critical strike power).

title: Fire Crystal 6–8 Age
description: Upgrades structures and units to FC 6, FC 7, and FC 8. Massive health scaling.

title: Generation 6 Heroes (Renee / Wayne / Wu Ming)
description: Renee (Lucky Wheel marksman carry), Wayne (Garrison defender), Wu Ming (Lancer debuff).

title: Pet Generation 6 (Titan Beaver & Gorgon Viper)
description: Unlocks Titan Beaver (Rapid healing) and Gorgon Viper (Toxic rally debuffs).

title: Generation 7 Heroes (Bradley / Edith / Gordon)
description: Bradley (Lucky Wheel fortress stun lead), Edith (Backline assassin), Gordon (Lancer).

title: Chief Gear T4 & Legendary Charms
description: Apex Chief Gear tier granting massive squad Lethality and Damage Reduction.

title: Generation 8 Heroes & Pet Gen 7
description: Hendrik (Lucky Wheel), Gatot, Sonya + Frostscale Chameleon (Camouflage evasion shield).

title: Fire Crystal 9–10 Age
description: Refined Crystal economy expansion; structure and unit mastery for FC 9 and FC 10.

title: Generation 9 Heroes (Magnus / Fred / Xura)
description: Magnus (Lucky Wheel), Fred (Lancer), Xura (Marksman).

title: Generation 10 Heroes (Blanchette / Gregory / Freya)
description: Blanchette (Lucky Wheel PvE sniper), Gregory (Infantry tank), Freya (Lancer).

title: Generation 11 Heroes (Eleonora / Lloyd / Rufus)
description: Eleonora (Lucky Wheel), Rufus (Armor shred), Lloyd (Lancer).

title: Fire Crystal 11–12 & T12 Troops
description: Apex Tier 12 troops and Maximum Fire Crystal mastery.

title: Generation 12 Heroes (Ligeia / Hervor / Karol)
description: Ligeia (Lucky Wheel Bear Trap carry), Hervor (Rally anchor), Karol (Lancer).

title: Generation 13 Heroes (Gisela / Flora / Vulcanus)
description: Gisela (Lucky Wheel tank), Vulcanus (Explosive burst), Flora (Lancer).

title: Generation 14 Heroes (Cara / Elif / Dominic)
description: Cara (Lucky Wheel marksman), Elif (Defense wall), Dominic (Lancer).

title: Generation 15 Heroes (Hank / Estrella / Viveca)
description: Hank (Lucky Wheel tank), Viveca (Marksman), Estrella (Lancer).

title: Generation 16 Heroes (Seigel / Ursar / Aisling)
description: Seigel (Lucky Wheel reflect tank), Aisling (Siege sniper), Ursar (HoH Lancer).

title: Generation 17 Heroes (Aiden / Bertha / Eleanor)
description: Aiden (Lucky Wheel Rage battery), Eleanor (Hall of Heroes 45% Armor Shred), Bertha (Support Healer).
